_readme: Rename this file to haf-secrets.json, in this same folder, next to manifest.json.
It is read on every install and every browser start, and fills in whatever is missing.
A key already in the browser always wins, so a stale file here cannot undo one you rotated.
Easier than filling this in by hand: on a machine that already works, open Settings and
press 'Download haf-secrets.json'. That writes this file for you, already named correctly,
with your real keys and every setting you have tuned.
haf-secrets.json is in .gitignore and is left out of tools/build-zip.sh unless you pass
--with-secrets. Anyone holding the folder holds these keys.
Delete this _readme key or leave it - it is ignored either way.
